forms.label: Standard
forms.sourceNote: Celery salt is ground celery seed cut with salt, typically about equal parts by commercial recipe; no USDA record exists for the blend itself. Figures here are Spices, celery seed (public domain) averaged 50/50 with plain sodium chloride (39,340 mg sodium per 100 g, sodium's own 39.3% share of NaCl's mass), which is why every figure is the arithmetic mean of the two rather than a measured figure — marked as such rather than sourced to a bottle. No density: it is a rimming salt, mixed into a thin layer on the glass rather than poured, and USDA's own portion is a teaspoon of packed powder.
